🚛 Contraband (2012) — Action / Thriller
Contraband follows Chris Farraday, a former smuggler who has left his criminal past behind to build a normal life with his family. When someone close to him gets into serious trouble, Chris is pulled back into the dangerous world he tried to escape.
He travels to Panama to smuggle a large shipment of counterfeit money, but the job quickly becomes more complicated than expected. With criminals, law enforcement, and unexpected problems closing in, Chris has to rely on his experience to protect the people he loves.
The movie explores family, loyalty, risk, redemption, and sacrifice.

source_details.synopsis: Contraband is a 2012 action thriller film directed by Baltasar Kormákur, and starring Mark Wahlberg, Kate Beckinsale, Ben Foster, Caleb Landry Jones, Giovanni Ribisi, Lukas Haas, Diego Luna and J. K. Simmons and follows a former smuggler who is coerced to smuggle illicit goods from Panama into the United States. The film is a remake of the 2008 Icelandic film Reykjavík-Rotterdam distributed by Universal Pictures.
